summary: Each person meets privately with their manager, and afterward a career-help provider explains services.
realLife: HR guidance says managers meet affected employees one by one within a short window, with counselors on site and an outplacement provider meeting people afterward.
sources: SHRM, Layoffs require communication, compassion, compliance: https://www.shrm.org/mena/topics-tools/news/talent-acquisition/layoffs-require-communication-compassion-compliance
inGame: Job-ended event written by the jobs module; outplacement does not exist, so it needs: an outplacement or help scene.
